data.name: Balaht
data.gender_notes: Balaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balaht is the Arabic name for Gazelle. It is a beautiful and agile animal known for its grace and power. In Islamic tradition, the Gazelle represents strength, resilience, and agility in the face of adversity. The name Balaht carries the meaning “Gazelle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Balaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gazelle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Balaht is a spiritual name that embodies the qualities of the Gazelle: grace, agility, and strength. It is a reminder to be resilient and adaptable in the face of challenges, and to move gracefully through life.
data.etymology: Balaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gazelle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balaht total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: بلहत
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يدل على الرفعة و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الرفعة و العلو و الارتفاع، و هو مشتق من الفعل 'بلَه' الذي يعني الرفع و الارتفاع. ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه يمكن أن يرتبط بمعنى البلوغ و النمو.

in_urdu.name: بلہت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بلہت ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے رفعت، علو، اور ارتفاع۔ یہ نام الفعل 'بلَه' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفع اور ارتفاع کرنا۔ بعض تفاسیر کے مطابق اس کا تعلق بلوغ اور نمو کے معنی سے بھی ہو سکتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس نام کا استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बलहट
in_hindi.long_meaning: बलहट एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है उन्नति, ऊंचाई और ऊपर उठना। यह नाम 'बलह' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है ऊपर उठाना और ऊंचा करना। कुछ व्याख्याओं के अनुसार इसका संबंध परिपक्वता और विकास के अर्थों से भी हो सकता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

Historically used within Islamic traditions, the name symbolizes spiritual and moral elevation. Across various Muslim cultures, Balaht is adopted for its positive and aspirational connotations.
